IAM & Privileged Access: IAM access population with employee status, account status, privilege and review fields.
Change Management: Production change tickets with approvals, testing, implementation and emergency review.
Vulnerability & Patch Management: Vulnerability findings with severity, age, remediation SLA and patch status.
Backup & Disaster Recovery: Backup job status, restore-test evidence and RPO measurements.

Third-Party Risk Management: Vendor criticality, due diligence, assurance report and contract security indicators.
Cloud Security Configuration: Cloud resource exposure, encryption, MFA, logging, security group and backup settings.
